name: kotlin-quality
description: Kotlin test, architecture, and library ABI review agents — meaningful tests, clean core, effects at the boundary, no broken releases

interface.shortDescription: Test, architecture, and ABI review for Kotlin projects
interface.longDescription: Reviews whether Kotlin tests prove the code works, whether the architecture can absorb change, and whether a published library keeps its ABI. Ships three review agents plus an installer that places them into Codex.
defaultPrompt: $kotlin-quality:install-codex-agents install the Kotlin review agents into Codex
$kotlin-quality:kotlin-review review the tests and architecture of this change
